comparison.objective: Move a stereo microscope into its storage tray; unlike commissioning and locking a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely stable bimanual transport, orientation, and tray placement of a bulky delicate instrument, versus small-tool insertion, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and tightening. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies the microscope is safely seated in its tray; no pose tolerance, grasp rules, damage limits, or rubric are available. Candidate requires repeated dynamic performance and witness-tested lock retention.
comparison.reason: Safe bulky-object transport and placement test a different ability and outcome from fine mechanical tuning and dynamic validation.
